noah_wong: opened PR to revise oboro-6b model card + catalog entry: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4799
noah_wong: Goal: tighten guidance on sequence lengths, add a compact throughput row with HW specs, update SDK examples to Async v4, and call out CPU fallback behavior for quantized variants. Asking for quick reviews before tomorrow's merge window.
emma_ross: Skimmed. The card currently says seq_limit: 8192 but the published benchmark CSV uses seq=4096. We should avoid implying we've validated sustained 8k.
diego_chen: Suggestion: two-line statement under "Limits": "Max supported by runtime: 8192 (not validated for sustained high-throughput); recommended production limit: 4096 for latency-sensitive workloads." Also add note that KV cache memory grows linearly with seq length.
sophie_docs: For SDK snippets: please change blocking generate -> async stream usage and rename param max_tokens -> max_new_tokens. Example should use the new AsyncClient pattern.
noah_wong: current snippet in PR: ```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
resp = client.generate(model="oboro-6b", prompt="Explain...", max_tokens=128)
print(resp.text)
```
noah_wong: will replace with: ```python
from redwood import AsyncClient
client = AsyncClient()
async with client.stream_generate(model="oboro-6b", prompt="Explain...", max_new_tokens=128) as s:
    async for chunk in s:
        print(chunk.text, end="")
```
emma_ross: Also add a short "compatibility at a glance" checklist near the top: hosted / dedicated / private, quantized variants: yes/no, recommended batch/window settings. Platform teams love that quick summary.
diego_chen: Bench-bot: the PR links to bench CSV at s3://redwood-bench/oboro-6b/2026-03-22.csv - CI link-check failed earlier. Can you ensure public link or mirror to GH assets?
noah_wong: Pushed update to fix S3 path and included a hardware column in the throughput mini-table (GPU model, batch size, seq len). Also added kv-cache note and the recommended phrasing. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4799

noah_wong: Found another truncated URL in the bench table - fixing now. ETA 10m.
bench-bot: re-run benchmarks requested (issue filed): https://github.com/redwood-inference/benchmarks/issues/227
sophie_docs: minor nit: in compatibility notes use "CPU fallback (quantized) impacts cold-start latency and reduces steady throughput by ~3x". Keep it short.

sophie_docs: LGTM, small inline editorial nits that I'll fix post-merge. Merge after CI is green.
